model_only_first_order_equations.response: delta_a(k)=b_a delta(k)+lambda_a S(k); S(k)=integral_q Gamma_i(k,q;n,z) v_i(q) delta(k-q), with real-field Gamma_i(-k,-q)=Gamma_i(k,q)*
model_only_first_order_equations.first_order_cross: P_LE=b_L b_E P_delta+lambda_L b_E Q+b_L lambda_E Q*+O(lambda^2); Q=P_Sdelta
model_only_first_order_equations.imaginary_odd: Im P_LE^(1)=(lambda_L b_E-b_L lambda_E) Im Q for real coefficients and a common S
model_only_first_order_equations.mixed_three_point: Q(k)=integral_q Gamma_i(k,q) B_{v_i delta delta}(q,k-q,-k), with momentum delta removed
model_only_first_order_equations.gaussian_null: jointly centered Gaussian linear v,delta have B_vdelta_delta=0 even with nonzero P_vdelta; no first-order signal from this quadratic S
model_only_first_order_equations.additional_spatial_parity_gate: A real-space scalar S=v dot grad(delta) and scalar delta in homogeneous isotropic parity-invariant ensemble have real P_Sdelta; nonzero mixed B alone does not imply Im Q. An actual LOS-dependent response/selection or different observable is required.
model_only_first_order_equations.limitations: This does not exclude physically allowed linear-in-v observable/tracer response, standard relativistic Doppler, wind-conditioned estimator, higher-order O(lambda^2), or a physical bispectrum from nonlinear evolution.

science_decision: A genuinely nonzero unweighted 2pt EV intrinsic odd contribution from the restricted quadratic wake response requires a physically computed mixed B_vdelta_delta with LOS-odd response projection and validated b_L,b_E,lambda_L,lambda_E; if jointly centered Gaussian and linear, this first-order contribution vanishes. E17D1 missing halo force history prevents computing Gamma; existing E10 single-k positive-wind conditional T not a substitution.
